headline: Indonesian Government Announces CPNS 2026 Recruitment Schedule
metaDescription: The Indonesian government has announced that CPNS 2026 registration will begin on November 27, with competency testing scheduled for early 2027.
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian government has scheduled the start of CPNS 2026 registration for November 27.
Minister of PAN-RB Rini Widayanti stated that the recruitment seeks to fill 167,113 civil servant positions.
Candidates are expected to undergo Basic Competency Selection and Field Competency Selection beginning in early 2027.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian Ministry of Administrative and Bureaucratic Reform (PAN-RB) recently confirmed the timeline for the 2026 Civil Servant Candidate (CPNS) recruitment process. Minister of PAN-RB Rini Widayanti announced that registration is set to open on November 27, 2026. This recruitment drive aims to address the national demand for 167,113 new state civil apparatus (ASN) personnel. Following the initial registration phase, the government plans to conduct selection exams, including the Basic Competency Selection (SKD) and Field Competency Selection (SKB), between January and March 2027. This announcement follows discussions held by the National Selection Committee (Panselnas) to finalize the recruitment timeline. The process is a significant administrative event for the Indonesian government, marking a coordinated effort to replenish and expand the public workforce across various state sectors starting early next year.
whyItIsViral: The topic has strong search interest and steady coverage across three news outlets following official government announcements regarding the recruitment timeline.
